name: agy-autonomous-mcp-modeling-plugin
description: High-completion autonomous 3D CAD/hard-surface modeling in Blender from multi-view blueprints via MCP. Features pixel-ruler calibration, handedness alignment, zero-clutter autonomous stepwise BMesh construction, and official Blender MCP reference architecture with on-demand recipes.
suggestedPrompts: 根据输入的三视图，自主在Blender中完成高精度三维建模并输出三视图对比图
为当前三视图生成像素坐标标定网格，解算比例尺并在Blender中分层建模
渲染当前Blender场景的三列轮廓比对图与双等轴测图，自主通过MCP检索工具进行比对与微调
